pulse.currentFocus: Session 334 audited all 185 pages from the marketing landing to the member panel and shipped 12 of 14 ranked items — while disproving 2 of them with measurement rather than building them. Four defects were live: _redirects splat rules that 301'd three Solara world pages, the legacy Franchise Architect build and two whole app trees into 404s; /ignis-health/ calling itself internal while protected only by robots.txt; a tracked duplicate sitemap the orphan gate had been told to ignore; and a newsroom that could spend three consecutive editions on one story because selection remembered dead hosts but not its own output. Two fixes were joins rather than builds — the pathway route data had existed unrendered since S201, and the 17 .ai/ canonical fact sheets were referenced by nothing until they reached sitemap, agents.json, JSON-LD, human cross-links and the answer engine's retrieval corpus. New surface: /evidence/, one front door for eight live-data pages, with freshness fetched live rather than baked and honest UNKNOWN states.
pulse.nextMilestone: Resolve the startup-brief vs revenue-resolver disagreement upstream in studio-ops via Ark cargo (it recurs at every date rollover); stop fact extraction accepting syndicated advertising copy as a sourced fact on a public surface; reconcile propagate-nav's stale arrays so the footer stops naming two retired routes; and complete the founder-reserved Obelisk relying-party/passkey ceremony when available.
blockers: identity/auth surfaces remain held on real-provider-e2e-pending: obelisk.identity.verify is missing OBELISK_RP_ID, OBELISK_RP_NAME, and OBELISK_RP_ORIGIN; obelisk-staging-registration is also missing. The S332 candidate is blast-radius-disjoint and its scoped production resolver is allowed, which does not resolve or bypass this hold.

identity: the provider chain is live and verified (discovery JSON, authorize redirect, JWKS, and the revocation route all answer correctly as of session 321). The production promotion is held only on the real-provider journey, whose remaining leg is a founder passkey ceremony — hardware-key enrollment is founder-reserved by CANON-019 and is deliberately not automatable.
rollback architecture: the GitHub Pages warm origin still follows mutable main; D-S303 requires explicit founder authorization before migrating to an immutable verified generation.
IGNIS freshness: stale in a studio-ops portfolio artifact this repo cannot write; resolve upstream rather than backdating.
The Dispatch has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double-opt-in confirmation email.

startup-revenue-agreement is red: the promoted v5 startup brief renders a revenue evidence age the shared resolver disagrees with, and context/SIGNALS.md — its documented fallback — is 18 days stale and reports 'not found'. Studio-ops brief-renderer owned; must not be fixed by editing the sibling repo.

now: [S334][CI/P1] Two CI workflows are red, neither newly broken by S334 — confirm before touching either. `E2E Test Suite / compliance` fails on `sibling-readme-missing` for Call-Of-Doodie, Gridiron-GM, mindframe and Solara: those sibling repos are not checked out on the runner, and the job was already failing this way at `8a44a027` (00:32 on 2026-09-01, before any S334 commit). The `e2e` job itself passes, including the Mobile rendered-runtime release contract. `Lighthouse CI` fails on one route at a time with a different route each run — `/community/` at −0.11 on `3881729`, then a news article at 0.88 vs 0.90 on `ae8a11f` — which is lab volatility on that runner, not a regression. Do NOT lower either threshold; corroborate across runs first.

[S334][MOBILE/P2] The mobile audit measures PRODUCTION by default, so it cannot see an undeployed change. playwright's baseURL defaults to `https://vaultsparkstudios.com`, and a local pass on a not-yet-deployed page is measuring the OLD live page. That is exactly how a P1 tap-target on the new pathway route reached CI: six local runs passed because they were probing the previous version. Set `BASE_URL` to a local preview when verifying an unshipped change, and add a route to the audit list only AFTER the deploy that ships it. Also run it at default concurrency — a `--workers=4` pass raced on findings.jsonl and persisted 139 of 215 cells, which reads as missing matrix cells rather than lost writes.

[S334][BUILD/P2] One generator is non-idempotent and it makes the receipt cascade unwinnable. Every `npm run build` rewrites a single `<style id="vs-yas-style">` line on `changelog/index.html`, which changes the candidate manifest, which invalidates the hash-bound mobile and visual receipts, which costs a ~26-minute re-probe. Find the writer (no script in `scripts/` greps for `vs-yas`) and make its output deterministic. Until then, the working order is: build once, settle, capture receipts, push — and never run a build between capture and push.

[S334][OBS/P1] `startup-revenue-agreement` is red and the cause is upstream, not here. The promoted v5 startup brief renders `Revenue sig. 1d old (2026-08-30)` while the shared resolver — the same one doctor uses — computes 2 days. Both clock paths inside `revenue-freshness.mjs` agree on 2 (`studioCalendarDate()` and the UTC default both return 2026-09-01), so the disagreement is in the v5 renderer's SIGNALS composition, which promotes over the v3 block that computed correctly. `context/SIGNALS.md`, the documented fallback, is 18 days stale and says `not found`, so a reader is keyed on an artifact its producer stopped writing. This is a studio-ops brief-renderer concern — ship `repo-question` or `pattern-share` cargo rather than editing the sibling repo. It surfaced only because the date rolled over mid-session; it will recur every session boundary until fixed.

[S334][NEWS/P2] Fact extraction accepts advertising copy as a sourced fact. The 2026-08-31 edition's first fact reads "Scott Gilbertson Top Shark Promo Codes for August 2026 Shark makes some seriously powerful vacuums..." sourced to the Wired article. `factCandidates()` scores for digits, proper nouns and reporting verbs and penalises marketing pronouns, but a syndicated promo block passes every filter. This is a public-surface truth issue, not a cosmetic one: it is rendered as a cited fact under a real publisher URL. Consider penalising sentences whose entities do not appear in the headline or topic title.

[S334][UX/P2] The footer still names two retired routes. `Vault Portal` (`/vault-portal/`) and `Value Breakdown` (`/membership-value/`) remain in the sitewide footer. Both now resolve via edge 301s rather than 404s, so nothing is broken — but the footer advertises routes that no longer exist as destinations. The footer is written by `propagate-nav.mjs`, which is the documented S329 landmine (its hand-maintained arrays are stale against the registry-driven pages), so this needs the arrays reconciled first, not a direct edit.

[S334][PERF/P3] Two audit items were disproved, not deferred — do not re-raise them without new measurement. The homepage's inline CSS is page-unique (7% overlap with the shared sheet) and its measured mobile LCP is ~900ms; the member dashboard measures FCP 860ms at 1,414 DOM nodes. A controlled A/B also confirmed S275's blocking-stylesheet decision (724ms vs 752ms median FCP), and the alarming 4,724ms `/games/` reading was a cold-start artifact of the first page load in a fresh browser process. Any future perf work here starts from a warmed-browser measurement, not from document size.

[S333][NEWS/P1] Readable-source breadth is the last untouched lever, and it is now isolated. ~70 topics are blocked by nothing except having no readable body: they are corroborated, castable, fresh, and unusable because every source is a Google News redirect. Corroboration cannot help them and clustering cannot either. The only remaining approaches are more publisher-direct feeds (probe reachability and 72h freshness first, as S333 did — four were added this way) or resolving aggregator items to publisher URLs by matching on entities rather than the current same-outlet headline rule. Measure with `--scan`, whose single-blocker headroom tally now reports this number directly.
next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
